body:
## Pull request overview

Adds a Claude Code–discoverable `CLAUDE.md` at the repo root to provide the same project-wide AI architecture context currently captured for GitHub Copilot, and documents the addition in the changelog while noting the parallel file in Copilot instructions.

**Changes:**
- Added root `CLAUDE.md` with project context + terminal-oriented build/test command quick reference.
- Updated `.github/copilot-instructions.md` with a sync note pointing to `CLAUDE.md`.
- Updated `CHANGELOG.md` to record the new Claude Code integration file.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 3 out of 3 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| `CLAUDE.md` | New Claude Code project context file including quick-reference commands and architectural guidance. |
| `CHANGELOG.md` | Records the addition of Claude Code integration via `CLAUDE.md`. |
| `.github/copilot-instructions.md` | Adds a note indicating `CLAUDE.md` exists and should be kept in sync. |

The `pnpm setup` explanation here is slightly inaccurate vs the actual root script (`package.json` uses `pnpm install && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`). Since this section is meant as a copy/paste quick reference for a terminal agent, it should mirror the exact command to avoid drift/confusion.
```suggestion
pnpm setup                    # pnpm install && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build
```

This adds a new `### Added` section under `[Unreleased]`, but the file already contains other `### Added` sections later in the same `[Unreleased]` block. To keep the changelog consistent and easier to scan, consider adding this bullet to the existing `[Unreleased]` “Added” section (or consolidating the duplicate headings) rather than introducing another `### Added` header.
```suggestion
### Changed
- **Claude Code integration (`CLAUDE.md`)** — Added root `CLAUDE.md` file so that [Claude Code](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code) automatically loads the project's system prompt when launched in the repository. Content is synced with `.github/copilot-instructions.md` and includes build/test quick-reference commands, all prime directives, monorepo structure, protocol domains, coding patterns, and domain-specific prompt references. This complements the existing GitHub Copilot instructions and `skills/` directory.
```

The changelog entry states the CLAUDE.md content is “synced with `.github/copilot-instructions.md` and includes build/test quick-reference commands”, but the Copilot instructions file doesn’t include those commands and currently has an older “Last synced” date. Consider rewording to clarify that CLAUDE.md is *based on* the Copilot instructions and *adds* a terminal command quick-reference (or update the Copilot file accordingly).
```suggestion
- **Claude Code integration (`CLAUDE.md`)** — Added root `CLAUDE.md` file so that [Claude Code](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code) automatically loads the project's system prompt when launched in the repository. The file is based on `.github/copilot-instructions.md` and adds a build/test terminal quick-reference, while also including the project's prime directives, monorepo structure, protocol domains, coding patterns, and domain-specific prompt references. This complements the existing GitHub Copilot instructions and `skills/` directory.
```

This sync note makes the Copilot instructions sound aligned with `CLAUDE.md`, but the header still says “Last synced … 2026-04-13” while `CLAUDE.md` says it’s synced as of 2026-04-16. To avoid confusion, update the sync date (and, if applicable, align any diverging sections like the monorepo root path shown later in this file).
